title: Remove 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution from footer

requirements.summary: Remove the 'Built with caffeine.ai' attribution text and any associated elements from the Footer component
acceptanceCriteria: The Footer component no longer renders any text or link referencing 'caffeine.ai' or 'Built with love'.
All pages that include the Footer (LandingPage, AdminDashboard, ApiReferencePage) show no such attribution.
No other footer content (brand logo, navigation links, trading disclaimer, copyright) is altered.

file_operations.description: Remove the 'Built with caffeine.ai' (or 'Built with love using caffeine.ai') attribution text and any associated JSX elements from the Footer component's return statement. Preserve all other footer content including the brand logo, navigation links, trading disclaimer, and copyright notice. Ensure the remaining footer layout and styling remain intact.
